description: Full-circle polar chart rendered from the base commit with the pointer just below the 3 o'clock spoke. The tooltip names a series on a different spoke and the reported highlight position is the top-left corner of the plotting area, which is where the tooltip box is parked. Re-captured from the base commit because the screenshots attached to the original issue were taken on the 2.x line and no longer reproduce on this tree.

The same chart on the same base commit with no pointer involved, shown next to the data that was passed in. Every spoke is plotted with the value of a series two positions away - the spoke labelled with the largest value is drawn shortest - which is the second half of the defect. No corrected-state render is supplied: the agent has to derive the target behaviour from these two frames.
